limitations: Customer lifecycle state is stored in tenant-scoped authoritative SQLite.
Lifecycle state does not rescore, rerank, replace, or override Smart Opportunity.

Tracked-card detail includes the immutable Decision Timeline and, when history exists, integrated v1.5 Decision Change Intelligence; historical entries are read from saved snapshots and are never recomputed with current evidence.

Decision Change Intelligence orchestrates saved timeline, counterfactual, profitability, outcome, and customer-action facts; the browser must not recompute decisions, price boundaries, profitability, or outcome assessments.
Older tracked resources with no immutable decision history remain visible and report timeline and Decision Change Intelligence as unavailable rather than reconstructed.
Portfolio reference values use only saved accepted exact completed-sale evidence behind explicit coverage and freshness gates; active asking prices are excluded.

Portfolio reference performance compares evidence-supported reference value with customer-entered acquisition cost. It is unrealized context, not an appraisal, guaranteed proceeds, or a fee/tax/liquidation estimate.
Review, decision-change, and Collection Signal alerts are in-app projections only; email, SMS, push, marketplace, and transaction delivery are not configured.
Decision-change alerts are derived only from immutable saved Decision Timeline transitions and do not rescore history.
Collection Signals explain material persisted monitoring changes and do not create acquisition, grading, or position verdicts.
No lifecycle action authorizes a bid, purchase, listing, offer, checkout, payment, or transfer.
